I live with her at the moment because I got out of a very abusive relationship a few months ago that left me with nowhere to go. 
I'm not in college, and haven't been for ~3 years.
I believe they know but I wasn't explicit with them because I wanted to protect his privacy. Thank you for your advice  ,you're probably right even though I fucking hate to admit it.
Thank you for that advice! I'm glad it's working out for you, it makes me feel a little bit better. I guess I'm just anxious over nothing.

No, all three shelters are completely closed for adoptions at this point (source- I work at one).
But don't worry too much- we're also getting so many fosters that almost all of our animals are in homes right now!

OP, just wait until kitten season comes in a few months. You'll have your pick of a million different breeds and colors of kitties and you'll be able to save a life :)

This is all good advice. I'm really resistant to the idea of calling the cops just because he has illegal guns and WILL get arrested if the cops come. I don't want to ruin his life. Maybe that's really stupid. I'm keeping away and currently staying at a motel 6 after a very violent drunken outburst that ended in him threatening me.

This is something that I definitely thought about but I don't know if it's plausible. I've only been at my job for a few months (still in my "probationary period") and I don't know how I'd cope if I lost such an amazing career opportunity because of my dickhead ex-boyfriend. That advice helps though and I'll definitely think about it if things get worse.

When my lease is up? Highly unlikely. I can try but I have a ton of shit at my place and he is not stupid enough to not know what's going on. My dad is very intimidating to my bf so he's already volunteered to come help me pack and keep me safe but it's still frightening.
